quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Stir until the powder has dissolved completely.
Taste the drink, and add sugar only if it is still too bitter.
Pour hot water over the coffee.
Put a spoonful of instant coffee into a mug.
quests.hint: Look at which steps refer to something an earlier step has already prepared: a mug, the coffee, the powder, the drink.
quests.explanation: Each step uses what the step before it created. The definite phrases "the coffee", "the powder" and "the drink" show the drink is being built up, and you can only judge its taste after the powder has dissolved.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Turn on the new phone and choose your language.
Wait while your favorite apps download and install.
Sign in with your email account to restore your contacts.
Connect to a Wi-Fi network so that the phone can go online.
quests.hint: Signing in to an account requires something that must already be working. What is it?
quests.explanation: A phone needs to be on before you set it up, and it needs an internet connection before it can check your account. Downloading your apps depends on being signed in, so it comes last.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Fold the two slanted edges in once more to make a pointed nose.
Fold the top corners in toward the center line.
Fold a sheet of paper in half lengthwise, then open it again.
Fold the plane in half along the center line and lift the wings.
quests.hint: Some folds only make sense after the paper already has a certain shape. Which shapes are mentioned?
quests.explanation: The center line comes from the first fold, the slanted edges appear only after the corners have been folded in, and the paper only becomes "the plane" near the end. Each new name shows progress.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Collect each item from the shelves.
Wrap the fragile ones in paper and place everything in a box.
Seal the box and stick the address label on top.
Check the order form to see which items the customer wants.
quests.hint: A worker cannot collect items before knowing which ones are needed, and cannot seal anything before it is full.
quests.explanation: The order form tells you what to pick, the items are gathered, and then they are packed. "The box" appears in the third sentence, so sealing it must come after.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Stir in the flour to make a thick dough.
Mix the butter and sugar until the mixture looks creamy.
Roll the dough into small balls and place them on a tray.
Bake the cookies until their edges turn golden.
quests.hint: The food is called by different names as it changes. Follow those names.
quests.explanation: Butter and sugar become a mixture, then a dough, then balls of dough, and finally cookies. The changing names show how far the recipe has progressed.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Choose a printer and the number of copies from the print menu.
Click Print and wait for the machine to start.
Open the document you want to print.
Collect the pages from the tray and check that none are missing.
quests.hint: Think about what a computer needs to know before it can send anything to a printer.
quests.explanation: You open the file, tell the computer how to print it, start the job, and only then can you collect paper from the tray. Each step needs the result of the step before it.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Lift the seedling gently out of its tray and set it in the middle of the pot.
Fill the gaps around the roots with more soil and press down lightly.
Water the plant well and place it in a sunny spot.
Half fill a flowerpot with fresh soil.
quests.hint: The word "more" only makes sense if soil has already been mentioned. What else depends on an earlier step?
quests.explanation: Soil goes in first, the seedling is set on it, and "more soil" fills the gaps around the roots. Watering "the plant" happens once it is properly potted.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Confirm your choice and wait for the email receipt.
Log in to the library website with your card number.
Choose one of the rooms that are still free at that time.
Pick a date and a time from the booking calendar.
quests.hint: Which step limits the options that appear in the next one?
quests.explanation: The site has to know who you are, then when you want a room, and then which rooms are free at that time. "That time" points back to the date and time you just picked.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Raise the frame by bending the poles into place.
Choose a flat spot and clear away any sharp stones.
Spread the tent out on the ground and thread the poles through the sleeves.
Pull each rope tight and fix it to the ground with a peg.
quests.hint: A frame cannot be raised until something has been prepared for it. What is being prepared?
quests.explanation: The ground is cleared, the tent and poles are laid out, the frame is raised, and the ropes are fixed last to hold it there. "The frame" refers to the poles put through the sleeves.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Let everything simmer until the carrots are tender.
Chop an onion and two carrots into small pieces.
Fry the onion in a little oil until it turns soft.
Add the carrots and enough water to cover them.
quests.hint: Something is added to the pot only after another ingredient has been cooked. Which one?
quests.explanation: Vegetables are chopped, the onion is fried, and the carrots and water join it before everything simmers. "Everything" in the last sentence includes both the onion and the carrots.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Under the subject line, suggest two possible times.
Write a subject line that explains the purpose of the meeting.
Read the message once more, then press Send.
Open a new message and type your colleague's address.
quests.hint: Find the sentence that describes a position on the screen. What must already be there?
quests.explanation: The address and subject line must exist before you can write "under the subject line", and checking the message comes before sending. "Then" marks the final action.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Place a white flower in the glass and leave it near a window.
Fill a glass with water and add ten drops of blue food coloring.
Notice that its petals have turned pale blue as the colored water traveled up the stem.
Check the flower after a full day.
quests.hint: Which sentence is an observation, and what must have happened before anything can be observed?
quests.explanation: The colored water is prepared, the flower is put in it, and the result is observed after a day. "Its petals have turned" describes a change that needs time.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Type the email address you used to register.
Follow the link inside it and choose a new password.
Click the link that says you forgot your password.
Open the message that the website sends to that address.
quests.hint: The website can only send a message after it receives something from you. What is it?
quests.explanation: You ask for help, give your email address, receive the message at "that address", and use the link "inside it". The references "that address" and "it" show the chain of dependence.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Take off the wheel and pull the damaged tube out of the tire.
Slide a new tube inside and pump it up until it feels firm.
Fit the wheel back onto the frame and turn it to check that it spins freely.
Turn the bicycle upside down so that it rests on the seat and handlebars.
quests.hint: The word "new" and the word "back" each depend on something removed earlier.
quests.explanation: The bike is positioned, the wheel and old tube come out, a new tube goes in, and the wheel goes "back" onto the frame. "New" contrasts with "damaged", and "back" implies it was taken off.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: She compares the total with the sales report printed by the register.
When the shop closes, the cashier counts the money in the till.
The envelope goes into the safe until the bank opens the next morning.
If the two numbers match, she puts the cash in an envelope.
quests.hint: Which step depends on a condition being met?
quests.explanation: The cashier counts, compares, and only if the numbers match does she seal the cash away. "The envelope" refers to the one mentioned in the previous sentence, and "the two numbers" refers to the total and the report.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Choose a topic that interests you and write down the main question.
Write a first draft by expanding each point into a paragraph.
Read the draft aloud to find mistakes and improve the wording.
Make an outline with three key points under that question.
quests.hint: Writers plan before they draft and draft before they revise. Which sentences show each stage?
quests.explanation: A question gives the essay direction, an outline organizes the answer, a draft turns points into paragraphs, and reading aloud improves what already exists. "That question" and "the draft" point back to earlier steps.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Cover the dough with a cloth and let it rest for half an hour.
Mix the flour and salt in a large bowl, then add warm water a little at a time.
Divide the rested dough into balls and roll each one flat.
Knead the mixture for ten minutes until the dough feels smooth.
quests.hint: One word describes the dough as it is after waiting. Which step must come before it?
quests.explanation: "The rested dough" can only be divided after it has been left to rest. The mixture becomes dough through kneading, and the dough rests before it is shaped.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Connect your camera to the computer with a cable.
Disconnect the camera safely once the copying bar has disappeared.
Open the folder that appears on the screen and select the photos you want to keep.
Drag the selected photos into a new folder on your desktop.
quests.hint: The folder "appears" because of one action, and the photos are "selected" before they are moved.
quests.explanation: The camera must be connected before its folder appears, photos are selected before they are dragged, and the cable is removed only when copying is complete. "Once" signals the final condition.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: After that, the system gives access to the staff calendar and shared files.
The manager sends the new employee's details to the IT department.
IT creates an account and emails a temporary password.
The employee logs in and is asked to choose a permanent password.
quests.hint: A temporary password suggests a further step. What could it be?
quests.explanation: IT cannot create an account without details, the employee cannot log in without a password, and access is granted after the permanent password is set. "Temporary" and "permanent" show progress, and "After that" points to the last stage.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Apply the first coat of paint with a roller.
Cover the floor and furniture with old sheets.
Fill any small holes in the wall and let the filler dry.
When the coat is dry, add a second one to cover any patches.
quests.hint: "A second one" only makes sense if there has already been a first. Which other step protects something?
quests.explanation: Surfaces are protected, the wall is repaired, paint is applied, and "a second one" comes after the first has dried. Repairing the wall before painting avoids painting over holes.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Squeeze the juice from six lemons into a large jug.
Fill the jug with cold water and stir well.
Serve the lemonade over ice and add a few mint leaves.
Dissolve half a cup of sugar in hot water and add it to the juice.
quests.hint: The name of the drink changes near the end. What has to be finished before it gets its final name?
quests.explanation: Juice is collected, sweetened, diluted, and only then called "the lemonade". "The juice" in the second sentence refers to what was squeezed in the first.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Wash your hands before touching the cut.
Rinse the cut under clean running water to remove any dirt.
Cover the cut with a bandage to keep it clean.
Press a clean cloth against it until the bleeding stops.
quests.hint: Which step protects the wound before you touch it, and which protects it after it is treated?
quests.explanation: Clean hands come before contact, rinsing removes dirt, pressure stops the bleeding, and a bandage protects the area at the end. "Until the bleeding stops" shows the pressing step must finish before covering.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Put the slide on the microscope stage and look through the eyepiece.
Add a drop of water and lower a cover slip over it.
Place a thin slice of onion skin on a glass slide.
Turn the focus knob slowly until the cells appear sharp.
quests.hint: A sample must be prepared before it is examined, and adjustments come after you can see something.
quests.explanation: The sample goes on the slide, is covered, is placed under the microscope, and is then focused. "The slide" in the third sentence refers to the prepared slide from the earlier steps.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Check that you can hear the teacher and that she can hear you.
Raise your virtual hand when you want to ask a question.
Allow the website to use your microphone and camera when it asks.
Click the link in your teacher's email a few minutes before the lesson.
quests.hint: You cannot test the microphone until the website has been given permission to use it.
quests.explanation: You enter the class, give permission, test your equipment, and then take part. The test only works after permission is given, and asking a question comes once the lesson is running.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Boil the pieces in salted water for fifteen minutes.
Peel the potatoes and cut them into equal pieces.
Taste the mash and add pepper before serving.
Drain the water and mash the potatoes with a little butter.
quests.hint: "The pieces" and "the mash" are new names for the same food. Which name comes from which step?
quests.explanation: Whole potatoes become pieces, then boiled pieces, then mash. Each new name tells you what has already been done, and seasoning comes after tasting.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Apologize and repeat the problem to show that you understand it.
Listen carefully while the customer explains the problem.
Offer a solution, such as a refund or a replacement.
Ask whether the solution is acceptable before you end the call.
quests.hint: You cannot repeat a problem until you have heard it, and you cannot check a solution until you have offered one.
quests.explanation: Understanding comes before responding, and a solution must be offered before it can be confirmed. "The problem" and "the solution" are repeated so that each step builds on the last.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Log in to your bank's app and open the payments menu.
Review the details on the screen before you confirm the payment.
Below the account number, type the amount due and pick a date.
Enter the company's name and the account number from your bill.
quests.hint: One step describes where something is on the screen relative to another step. Which step must already exist?
quests.explanation: You log in first, enter who to pay, and then enter how much and when, "below the account number" you just typed. Reviewing everything is the last check before confirming.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: On the day, they present in turn, following the plan they made.
The group divides the topic into parts, and every member takes one part.
Members research their parts and write a few notes.
The teacher assigns each group a topic for a short talk.
quests.hint: Which sentence sets the task, and which shows the final performance of it?
quests.explanation: A topic is given, divided among members, researched, and then presented. "Their parts" and "the plan they made" refer back to the division of work.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Slide the pizza into a very hot oven.
Take it out when the cheese bubbles and the crust turns brown.
Roll the dough into a thin circle on a floured table.
Spread tomato sauce over it and scatter cheese on top.
quests.hint: The food is only called "the pizza" once it is assembled.
quests.explanation: The dough is shaped, topped, and baked, and it is removed when it looks done. "It" in the second sentence refers to the dough, and "the pizza" appears after the toppings are added.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Tap Update next to the app you want to refresh.
Look through the list of apps that have updates waiting.
Reopen the app once the button changes to Open.
Open the app store and tap your profile picture.
quests.hint: A list appears only after a certain screen has been opened. Which one?
quests.explanation: You reach your profile, see the list of waiting updates, choose one, and reopen the app when it is ready. "The list" and "the button" only make sense once those screens have been reached.
